name: play_start
title: setup for MANUAL.md: t-v16 loaded and its SONG playing (the load opens on the project's saved pattern, 5, where only T01 sounds), left playing (for the USB AUDIO capture on the PC); play_stop ends it

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
(the pads mode is set before the Shift layer, as cpu_mute_ab does: a former run may have left another one)

steps.say: the project saves tracks 1 6 7 8 muted: no mute is left to chance (a blind tap toggles): the MUTE row is read back from the pad LEDs and only a wrong pad is tapped, then asserted

steps.note: arm play_start: the TRACKS layer works on the Pattern screen only
a solo left on is tapped off (only a lit pad is tapped)
a mute is tapped only where it is wrong (MUTE row: lit = muted)
the mute state is as wanted (none)
